subject.title: [Bug] ACP sessions_spawn with opencode agentId: session registered but 0 bytes transcript (silent failure)

question: Should OpenClaw preserve successful empty ACP completions for compatible harnesses while requiring a typed error only for visible agent sessions that demonstrably never start model or tool dispatch?
rationale: The assigned reviewer identifies empty completion as an existing acpx contract, while the related tracker proposes a stronger visible-turn invariant; selecting the permanent boundary requires maintainer intent after a live OpenCode trace identifies which path is occurring.

options.title: Preserve generic empty completion
options.body: Keep the existing generic ACP contract and fix only a proven OpenCode launch, model-control, or event-forwarding defect.

options.title: Add a visible-turn invariant
options.body: Define and test a typed failure for visible ACP sessions that complete without ever beginning model or tool dispatch, while preserving valid non-visible harness behavior.

recommendation.title: Preserve generic empty completion
recommendation.body: Keep the existing generic ACP contract and fix only a proven OpenCode launch, model-control, or event-forwarding defect.

likelyOwner.reason: They are assigned to the issue and have already documented the relevant acpx contract boundary.
